game.title: Nada Gaman
game.description: Traditional stilt walking competitions where participants race or perform on wooden stilts. Tests balance, coordination, and endurance.
howToPlay: Step 1: Players construct or obtain wooden stilts with footrests.
Step 2: They practice walking and balancing on stilts.
Step 3: Races are held over set distances.
Step 4: Players compete for speed while maintaining balance.
Step 5: Trick competitions involve stunts and maneuvers.
Step 6: Falling off results in disqualification.
Step 7: Endurance contests see who can stay on stilts longest.
Step 8: Develops core strength and balance.
Step 10: Winners receive prizes and recognition.
